figural content stacked in vertical registers/zones
band or field of repeated linear/geometric pattern
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry profile quadrupeds and other motifs in low relief distributed in stacked zones on a tall upright slab, plus some repeated linear patterning. Beyond that the content diverges completely — A shows an assemblage of wild animals (canid, birds, snake-like and insect-like creatures) with no human presence, no frame and no narrative link, while B is a framed composition with a continuous interlace border enclosing a mounted rider above and a large ship below, relationships and motifs entirely absent from A.
